title: New Tire Set Parts Reduction — Alignment Services & Plans Adjustment Parts
content:
**Rule.** On the latest work order of an Alignment Services & Plans plan, a new-set parts reduction takes a percentage of the kit charge off the parts charge when the vehicle carries a recently installed Crestline tire set under Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.

| Vehicle's active Crestline tire set | Its tire line includes a complimentary alignment check | Reduction, as a percentage of the kit charge |
|---|---|---|
| Installed no more than 30 calendar days before the visit (the visit date included) | Yes | 10% |
| Installed no more than 30 calendar days before the visit | No | 5% |
| No active Crestline tire set installed within those 30 days | — | 0% |

The 30 days are the tire bundle window of every Alignment Services & Plans line, counted from the tire set's install date to the visit date. The reduction is worked out on its own, as a percentage of the kit charge, and taken off the parts charge, which is rounded to the nearest cent.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical):** a set installed exactly 30 days before the visit qualifies; one installed 31 days before does not. On a kit charge of 80.00 with a 10-day-old set whose line includes an alignment check, 8.00 is taken off the parts charge.
